NARRATIVE AND PLANS

TYPE IJ Rezoning Attachment

1457-59 North Talman Avenue
From RS-3 to RM-5

The Property
The subject property is improved with a vacant church building. The surrounding area is comprised of varying

zoning districts, including RS-3, RT-4, RT-4.5. RM-5, and a nearby Planned Development. The area is improved
with buildings of various heights ranging from 1 to 4 stories that contain primarily residential uses. The property
is also a Transit Served Location per the Transit Oriented Provisions of Chicago Zoning Ordinance (Section 17-
10-0102-B (1)) as it is within 722 feet of the North Avenue Bus Line Corridor Roadway Segment.

The Project
The Applicant proposes to improve the property by converting the church into a two-story residential building

with 8 units and 4 automobile parking spaces. 8 bicycle parking spaces will be provided. The zoning height of the
building will remain unchanged at 46 feet. To allow the proposed development, the Applicant seeks a zoning
change for the subject property from an RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District to a RM-5
Neighborhood Mixed-Use District. The Applicant is filing a Type 1 rezoning application and seeks all relief
necessary and as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the proposed project, including: 1) a variation under
sections 17-13-1101-A and 17-13-1003-K to reduce the required rear yard open space to allow for the construction
of automobile and bicycle parking spaces in the rear; 2) a variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the rear
yard setback from 37.5 feet to 36.11 feet; 3) a variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the south side and
north side setbacks from 9.1’ and 2.3° to 0° to allow three patios not over 4 feet above the average level of the

adjoining ground.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 6,250 sq. ft.

Floor Area: 7,025 sq. ft.

FAR: 2.0

Residential Dwelling Units: 8

MLA Density: 781.25 sq. ft.

Height: 46 ft. (existing)

Automobile Parking: 4

Bicycle Parking: 8

Setbacks:
Front (N. Talman) 4.7 (existing)
Side (North) 0 (proposed)
Side (South) 0’ (proposed)

Rear (alley) 36.11’ (proposed)
